newsitem.title: UK: ICI down ahead of results next week.
newsitem.headline: ICI down ahead of results next week.

text.p: Shares in UK chemicals group ICI Plc stumbled on Friday, despite the weakness in sterling and a generally firmer stock market, as investors looked ahead to the release of next week's annual results, dealers said.
By 1101 GMT, the stock had slipped 13-1/2p to 738-1/2 on volume of 1.9 million shares.
ICI is set to publish its full-year results on February 6. Analysts estimate the company earned between 610 million and 620 million stg before taxes and exceptionals.
Many have trimmed their profit forecast because of the appreciation of sterling, which will eat into overseas profits.
One dealer said yesterday's disappointing results from Dow Chemicals of the U.S. rekindled concerns about ICI's figures.
Another called today's decline an overreaction. "Chemical results have been bad across the globe. ICI's will probably be bad, but it's what everyone is expecting."
